metadata.methods_description: EEG signals were recorded from 11 healthy subjects (8 male, 3 female; age 24-39 years) using a 256-channel EGI 300 Geodesic EEG System with HydroCel Geodesic Sensor Net montage at 250 Hz sampling rate and Cz reference. Subjects performed an SSVEP task focusing on flickering visual stimuli presented at five frequencies (6.66, 7.50, 8.57, 10.00, 12.00 Hz) for 5-second trials separated by 5-second rest periods. Each subject completed one session with 5 runs. Leave-one-subject-out cross-validation was employed for algorithm evaluation across signal processing stages: filtering (FIR vs IIR), artifact removal (AMUSE vs FastICA), feature extraction (PWelch, Periodogram, PYULEAR, DWT, STFT, Goertzel), feature selection, and classification (SVM, LDA, kNN, Naive Bayes, Random Forest, AdaBoost).

By using established techniques to reconstruct the sensors' sources' neural activity it is possible to decode from voxels for MEG data as well.
